commonCombinations.description: Remap noise values to control ranges

troubleshooting: Noise looks static: Animate Translate parameter with absTime.seconds
Noise too blocky: Increase Harmonics for more detail
Noise too smooth: Reduce Period for tighter patterns
Want fluid motion: Output Curl 3D attribute for divergence-free flow
description: Applies noise fields (Perlin/Simplex 2D-4D) to point positions and attributes. Outputs raw noise, gradient (rate-of-change), and curl (twist) attributes. Supports per-point parameter mapping for spatially varying noise.
